name: claude-unity-skills
description: Marketplace for Unity Editor automation plugins — install only the domains you need.

plugins.name: unity-core
plugins.description: Optional deep-dive companion — full REST protocol detail, operating-mode/error-code reference, and manual guide-mode docs. Not required by the other plugins.

plugins.name: unity-scene-authoring
plugins.description: Create and edit GameObjects, Components, Prefabs, and Scenes in the Unity Editor from chat.

plugins.name: unity-rendering
plugins.description: Configure Unity rendering from chat — materials, lights, shaders, Shader Graph, URP, post-processing, decals.

plugins.name: unity-ui
plugins.description: Build Unity UI from chat — UGUI and UI Toolkit.

plugins.name: unity-scripting
plugins.description: Create and edit C# scripts and ScriptableObjects, plus scripting-design advisories.

plugins.name: unity-assets-pipeline
plugins.description: Manage Unity's asset pipeline — import, cleanup, optimization, packages, validation.

plugins.name: unity-animation-timeline
plugins.description: Automate Animator, Timeline, Cinemachine, and Scene View camera control.

plugins.name: unity-physics-navigation
plugins.description: Automate physics, NavMesh, Terrain, and ProBuilder mesh editing.

plugins.name: unity-addressables-yooasset
plugins.description: Automate Addressables and YooAsset hot-update pipelines, plus HybridCLR.

plugins.name: unity-tweening
plugins.description: Automate DOTween Pro and PrimeTween tween/sequence authoring, plus UniTask patterns.

plugins.name: unity-dev-workflow
plugins.description: Cross-cutting Editor developer workflow tools — batch execution, diagnostics, testing, profiling.

plugins.name: unity-architecture-advisory
plugins.description: Design-time advisory guidance — project inspection, architecture planning, ADRs, performance review.

plugins.name: unity-editor-tools
plugins.description: Low-level fallback tooling — YAML hand-editing, experimental Unity CLI, Behavior graphs.
